title: Genre Profile
description: The DATA that adapts the deterministic pipeline to a document genre (axis C). A profile is either a BASE/STANDALONE profile (carries the full role machinery) or an OVERLAY that `extends` another and only specifies deltas. Resolution (base+overlays merged) must itself satisfy the base form — enforced by contracts.resolve_profile, not here.

extends.description: Parent profile id (Phase 3 layering). Present ⇒ this is an overlay; merged onto the parent before use.

capabilities.description: Phase 5 capability negotiation: what the matched template can render. Missing keys ⇒ assumed false/absent; the logical tier degrades gracefully.

then.description: A standalone/base profile must carry the full role machinery.

//comment: Keys prefixed with // in profile JSON files are human comments; contracts.py strips them before validation.
